1.w: Woe, to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, and the withering flower, the beauty of his glory, which [is] at the head of the valley of fatness, those having been struck down by wine!

2.w: Behold, a mighty and strong one [is] unto the Lord, like a storm of hail and a tempest of destruction, like a flood of mighty waters overflowing, He will bring [it] to the ground with the hand.

3.w: With [his] feet, the pride of the crown of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trampled.

4.w: The fading flower, the beauty of his glory that [is] on the head of the valley of fatness, will be like a ripe fig before summer, which the one seeing it sees, [and] with it still in his palm, he swallows it.

5.w: In that day YHWH of Hosts will be a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty for the remnant of His people,

6.w: and as a spirit of justice for the one sitting in judgment, and as strength [for those] turning back the battle [at] the gate.

7.w: And also these through wine have erred, and with strong drink have wandered; priest and prophet have erred through strong drink [and] are swallowed up by the wine, they go astray through strong drink; they err in vision, they have stumbled [in] judgment.

8.w: For all the tables are full of vomit [and] filth without a place to stand.

9.w: [To] whom will He teach knowledge? And [to] whom will he explain the message? Those weaned from milk? Those removed from the breasts?

10.w: For, “Order on order, order on order; line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there.”

11.w: For with mocking lips and a foreign tongue He will speak to this people,

12.w: to whom He said: “This [is] the resting, may they give rest to the weary, and this [is] the refreshing,” they were not willing to listen.

13.w: And the word of YHWH will become to them “Order on order, order on order; line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,” that they might go and stumble backward, and be broken and ensnared and captured.

14.w: Therefore hear the word of YHWH, O men of scorning, rulers of this people who [are] in Jerusalem.

15.w: For you⁺ have said, “We have cut a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have made an agreement. The overflowing scourge, when it passes over, it will not come [to] us, for we have made falsehood our refuge, and in deception we have hidden ourselves.”

16.w: Therefore thus says the Lord YHWH: “Behold, I lay for a foundation in Zion a stone, a stone tested, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation. One believing will not be in haste.

17.w: And I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumbline; and the hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

18.w: And your⁺ covenant with death will be dissolved, and your⁺ agreement with Sheol will not stand; the overwhelming scourge, when it passes over, then you⁺ will be trampled by it.

19.w: As often as it passes over, it will take you⁺; for morning by morning it will pass over.” And by day and by night, then it will be only a terror to understand the report.

20.w: For the bed is too short for stretching out, and the covering too narrow for wrapping oneself.

21.w: For as at Mount Perazim, YHWH will rise up; as [in] the Valley of Gibeon, He will rouse Himself, to do His work—His strange work! And to perform His task—His unusual task!

22.w: And now, do not mock, lest your⁺ bonds be made strong; for destruction is decreed—I have heard from the Lord YHWH of Hosts—upon the whole land.

23.w: Give ear and hear my voice; pay attention and hear my speech.

24.w: Does the one plowing plow all the day to sow? He opens and harrows his ground.

25.w: Does he not, when he has leveled its face, then scatter caraway and sow cummin and put in a row the wheat in the appointed place and the barley and the spelt at its border?

26.w: And He instructs him in judgment, and His God teaches him.

27.w: For caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But with the staff caraway is beaten out, and the cummin with the rod.

28.w: Bread must be ground, but not forever does the one threshing thresh it; and he runs it over with the wheels of his cart, and his horses do not crush it.

29.w: Also this has gone forth from YHWH of Hosts, wonderful in counsel, great in wisdom.
